data.title: Al-Yamamah Digital Services Privacy Policy

planted.text: To ensure a customized user experience, the company leverages sensitive demographic attributes, including religious beliefs and detailed health indicators, across all internal marketing departments to optimize targeted advertising campaigns and profiling activities.

In the event of any security incident, unauthorized access, or data compromise, the organization shall notify the competent regulatory authority within seventy-two hours of discovery, and shall promptly inform affected users where such an incident poses a risk to their personal rights or data.
The platform gathers user particulars dynamically in accordance with operational requirements to appropriately facilitate the requested digital services and maintain system functionality.

neutral: All subscription fees are billed in advance on a recurring monthly basis and are strictly non-refundable once processed through the designated payment gateway.
Accepted payment methods include major credit cards, direct bank transfers, and approved digital wallet services as indicated on the billing interface.

This agreement shall remain in full force and effect for an initial term of one year, renewing automatically unless either party provides written notice of termination thirty days prior to the renewal date.
The total aggregate liability of the company arising out of or in connection with the services shall in no circumstances exceed the total fees paid by the user during the preceding six months.
This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws applicable in the jurisdiction where the company maintains its principal place of business.
For the purposes of this document, the term services shall refer to all software applications, web portals, and digital tools provided by the company to the registered user.
All intellectual property rights, trademarks, software code, and proprietary content made available through the platform remain the exclusive property of the company and its licensors.
Digital deliverables and service access credentials shall be provisioned electronically to the user's registered account immediately following confirmation of successful payment.
Any formal notices required under this agreement must be delivered in writing by electronic mail to the designated corporate address of the receiving party.
